{{Item infobox | description = Can be used in the [[Mystic Forge]] in place of [[Twilight]] to add the greatsword [[Eternity]] to your [[Legendary Armory]].
{{red|If you have two instances of Eternity unlocked in the armory, please contact [[Guild Wars 2 Support Team|Customer Support]].}} | type = trophy | rarity = legendary | bound = account | id = 95086 }} [[Memory of Twilight]] is a [[token]] that can be used in an alternate recipe to [[Mystic Forge|forge]] [[Eternity]]. == Acquisition == * Upon adding Twilight to the Legendary Armory. ** This includes when Twilight is automatically added to the Armory when logging in on a character with Twilight equipped or account-bounded in the inventory for the first time after the release of the Legendary Armory on [[Game updates/2021-07-13|July 13, 2021]]. == Used in == {{Recipe list}} == Notes == * An Eternity created from Memory of Sunrise and Memory of Twilight will be automatically bound to your Legendary Armory and can't be sold. * Despite the item's description suggesting that it is interchangeable with [[Twilight]], you cannot mystic forge it with [[Sunrise]] and instead must forge it with [[Memory of Sunrise]]. == See also == * {{item icon|Memory of Sunrise}} * {{item icon|Twilight}} [[de:Erinnerung an Dämmerung]] [[es:Recuerdo de Crepúsculo]] [[fr:Souvenir de Crépuscule]]
title: Memory of Twilight
